lead: Cartagena is a true paradise for shopping lovers. From elegant malls to colorful craft markets, the city offers options for all tastes and budgets.

serrezuela.title: La Serrezuela mall
serrezuela.text: For a modern and cultural experience, visit La Serrezuela, a former bullring turned into a mall with exclusive boutiques, luxury dining, and spectacular views, located in the historic center.

crafts.title: Crafts
crafts.text: If you’re looking for authentic souvenirs, you’ll find many shops in the historic center and Getsemaní.
crafts.bovedas: Las Bóvedas de Santa Clara, a series of shops in the historic wall selling crafts like bags, vueltiao hats, hammocks, ceramics, and jewelry.
crafts.sanDiego: Plaza de San Diego: from 5pm, craft vendors set up.
crafts.serrezuela: La Serrezuela mall offers premium and luxury shops.
crafts.walk: Walk the streets to find many shops.
crafts.getsemaniMall: Centro comercial Getsemaní: various shops with bags, jewelry, and other crafts.

tips.title: Useful tips
tips.cash: Bring cash in Colombian pesos, especially for local markets.
tips.street: Avoid buying on the street to ensure quality and authenticity.
tips.belongings: Protect your belongings in crowded places.
tips.emeralds: If buying emeralds or jewelry, look for certified shops.

malls.title: Malls
malls.text: In Plaza Bocagrande and Caribe Plaza, you’ll find national and international brands, restaurants, and entertainment.
